title: Copilot-reviewed pull request merge metrics now in the usage metrics API
summary: GitHub now officially tracks merge metrics for PRs created by Copilot coding agents. This validates that agent-authored code is a primary production flow that requires dedicated monitoring and governance.

title: Show HN: Skilldeck – Desktop app to manage AI agent skill files across tools
summary: An app built entirely by Claude Code using a 'harness engineering methodology' including a 'regression gate based on a surfaces map'. This confirms that sophisticated developers are already building custom external gates to manage autonomous agent output.

title: We went from 3 agents to 40 in four months. Nobody knows what half of them do anymore
summary: A viral discussion about agent sprawl and the lack of visibility into agent actions. Highlights the need for a centralized enforcement layer like Permission Protocol as agents scale from 1-2 to 10+ per team.

title: How to Review AI-Generated Code: The Complete Developers Guide
summary: Highlights that privilege escalation and authentication bypasses in production are the primary risks of unreviewed AI code. Perfectly matches the 'Consequence Engine' value proposition.

title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: An open-source orchestration system that automates the full lifecycle of AI agents from ticket to merged PR. It monitors CI and merge readiness every 30s. This is an 'execution' layer that needs a 'permission' layer.
